issues.description: Field mismatch for class member Bitmap24::width: in the template repository (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) the member is declared as 'short width;' while in the solution repository (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) it is declared as 'int width;'. This difference in declared type for the same public attribute can confuse students: the starter code shows a narrower type (short) while the reference uses int, which affects range, arithmetic promotions, and expectations when reading or modifying code that uses width (e.g., buffer allocation width*height*3).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration of Bitmap24::width consistent between template and solution. Prefer changing the template repository declaration from 'short width;' to 'int width;' (matching the solution) and rebuild or update any comments/documentation to state the intended type. This preserves expected numeric range for image widths and avoids surprising truncation or promotion differences when students compare their work to the reference implementation.
